import z3

# Define variables
vertices = [[z3.Int(f"v{g}_{i}") for i in range(3)] for g in range(7)]
all_labels = [vertices[g][i] for g in range(7) for i in range(3)]

# Collect edges
edges = []
# Triangle edges
for g in range(7):
    edges.append((vertices[g][0], vertices[g][1]))
    edges.append((vertices[g][0], vertices[g][2]))
    edges.append((vertices[g][1], vertices[g][2]))
# Connecting edges
for g in range(6):
    for i in range(3):
        edges.append((vertices[g][i], vertices[g+1][i]))

# Differences
diffs = [z3.Abs(u - v) for u, v in edges]

# Constraints
constraints = (
    [z3.And(0 <= x, x <= 39) for x in all_labels] +
    [z3.Distinct(all_labels)] +
    [z3.And(1 <= d, d <= 39) for d in diffs] +
    [z3.Distinct(diffs)]
)

# Solve
solver = z3.Solver()
solver.add(constraints)
result = solver.check()
print(result)
if result == z3.sat:
    model = solver.model()
    solution = [[model.evaluate(vertices[g][i]) for i in range(3)] for g in range(7)]
    print(solution)
else:
    print("UNSAT")

    edges.append((vertices[g][0], vertices[g][1]))
    edges.append((vertices[g][0], vertices[g][2]))
    edges.append((vertices[g][1], vertices[g][2]))
# Connecting edges
for g in range(6):
    for i in range(3):
        edges.append((vertices[g][i], vertices[g+1][i]))

# Differences
diffs = [z3.Abs(u - v) for u, v in edges]

# Constraints
constraints = (
    [z3.And(0 <= x, x <= 39) for x in all_labels] +
    [z3.Distinct(all_labels)] +
    [z3.And(1 <= d, d <= 39) for d in diffs] +

)
